assertions.name: 3H_closure_non_hyperbolic
assertions.source: ³H closure admits no geometric (positively-oriented) triangulation ⇒ non-hyperbolic (Vol→0), vs the hyperbolic 8_11 (Vol=8.286).

description: Naive Markov closure of the canonical operator-valued atomic braid word does NOT reproduce the SDP binding links at any A (³H closure is 4-component vs 8_11's 1; ³He closure 4-comp vs Borromean's 3; all non-hyperbolic). So closure cannot supply the ⁴He 4-body link volume; Vol₄ ≈ 8.046 stays an unverified bond-count back-out gated on the SDP/canonical-knot-ID (conj #604) at A=4. SnapPy 3.3.2 verified (fig-8 = 2.0298832). Scope-(a) negative, no fit.
